description: Full-text search across published news, newsletter issues, podcast episodes, public entity pages, funding rounds and products. Result kinds: news, newsletter, podcast, company, investor, person, topic, country, funding_round, product; funding_round results also carry company, round_type (as recorded; null when not disclosed), round_label (a stage derived from the amount, only when round_type is empty; not the official round name), category, amount, currency, display_amount and announced_at; news, newsletter and podcast results carry editorial_format ('news', 'analysis' or 'signals'). Arguments: q (or query): text to search for, at least 2 characters — required, this tool has no plain-list mode. editorial_format (optional, 'news' | 'analysis' | 'signals'; 'signals' = the monthly funding report, see get_signals_report): return only publication items with that format. Unknown arguments are rejected.

editorial_format.description: Optional: only news/newsletter/podcast items with this format.

q.description: q (or query): text to search for (required, min 2 characters).

query.description: Alias of q; q wins if both are sent.

name: search_content
title: Search the publication
